_note: Everything an attendee can see is in this file. No code changes needed to rewrite the booth's voice. Run `npm run lines` after editing - it checks every line still sets legibly in at least three templates.

options.label: The one who talks to users
The one who just got here

_lines: Keys are `who|confession`. A `*` matches any answer, so `*|friday` covers every identity. Specific beats general: an exact pair is offered first, then the confession-only lines, then the identity-only ones. Three get shown. Write the specific ones where the combination is actually funnier than its parts - that is where this stops feeling like mad libs.
